verdict.rationale: Better Auth's organization plugin lets teams assign roles and permissions per-org/team, and the admin plugin manages user roles, which provides some resource-scoped (team/org) access control beyond a single global role — but this is still fundamentally RBAC, not a documented policy- or relationship-based (ReBAC/ABAC) authorization engine with custom resource-level rules or relationship graphs. missing for 10: no evidence of a policy engine, attribute-based rules, or relationship-based (Zanzibar-style) permission model; no docs describing per-resource ACLs beyond org/team roles.
